free_tier.stated: unlimited static requests; 100,000 Function invocations per day; 25 MiB per asset

egress.terms: not metered for static assets; Functions are counted per invocation, not per byte

chaining: serves static bytes with no meter, so it is the free front for an object set that fits the 25 MiB cap; the cap sets the shard size and the volume does not bind.

limits.value: 100,000 Function invocations per day, shared with Workers

reliability_note: a build is a write gate; 500 builds per month on the free plan

evidence.proved: 25 MiB per static asset and 100,000 Function requests per day

notes: This record owns the egress term only. The storage arithmetic belongs to the storage topic and is not restated here.

extras.transit_note: static assets leave Cloudflare's edge on every request; the request count is metered, the bytes are not
